notification: Your favorite books will gather dust.
Your chair will outlast your body.
How many sunsets do you have left?
When did you last watch the stars?
What are you really waiting for?
When did you last feel alive?
Your regrets won't die with you.
Can you recall last year's dreams?
What binds you to this moment?
TIME IS NOT ON YOUR SIDE.

main.text: It is not death that a man should fear, but he should fear never beginning to live.
main.author: Marcus Aurelius

main.text: The fear of death follows from the fear of life. A man who lives fully is prepared to die at any time.
main.author: Mark Twain

main.text: Life is too important to be taken seriously.
main.author: Oscar Wilde

main.text: The only way to deal with an unfree world is to become so absolutely free that your very existence is an act of rebellion.
main.author: Albert Camus

main.text: To the well-organized mind, death is but the next great adventure.
main.author: J.K. Rowling

main.text: Death is nature’s way of telling you to slow down.
main.author: Dick Sharples

main.text: The day which we fear as our last is but the birthday of eternity.
main.author: Seneca
